rationale: The agent performed write actions without authenticating the user or obtaining explicit confirmation. Tool logs show direct calls to modify_pending_order_items and modify_user_address without any prior confirmation step, violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. There is no evidence of user authentication beyond a name/ZIP lookup, which is insufficient per policy. The agent also did not first present the existing address(es) for verification before overwriting, and there’s no confirmation that the replacement item is indeed the “easiest” or acceptance of any pricing/shipping implications. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
